annotations.title: IEEPA tariff refund and interest ledger

description: Track IEEPA duty paid, refunds received and estimated interest owed, entry by entry. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

asOf.description: Calculate interest through this date for unrefunded duty (YYYY-MM-DD). Usually today, or the date you expect the refund.

entries.description: Entries with IEEPA duty paid. One row per entry summary with IEEPA duty. Your broker or ACE reports list the entries and duty paid.

duty.description: IEEPA duty paid (US dollars). Only the IEEPA tariff portion of the duty on this entry, not regular HTS, Section 301 or Section 232 duty.

interestPaid.description: Interest received with the refund (US dollars). Interest CBP paid with the refund, if any.

label.description: Entry reference label (no importer IDs). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for entry reference label (no importer ids). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

paid.description: Date the IEEPA duty was paid (YYYY-MM-DD). The date the duty deposit was paid to CBP for this entry.

refundDate.description: Refund date (YYYY-MM-DD; ignored if no refund yet). The date the refund was paid. Leave the example date when the refund is 0.

refunded.description: Refund of that duty received so far (US dollars). Principal refunded to date; enter 0 if nothing has been refunded.

payer.description: Importer of record type. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for importer of record type. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: individual = Not a corporation (sole proprietor, partnership, LLC taxed as one); corporate = Corporation.

rateCorp.description: Annual overpayment interest rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Corporate overpayment rate for the quarter beginning October 1, 2026. Enter a different single rate if your entries span other quarters. Official reference value 6% from CBP quarterly IRS interest rates notice (Federal Register 2026-19292) and IRS quarterly interest rates page, effective 2026-10-01 (quarter Oct 1 to Dec 31, 2026). Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when payer is corporate; ignored otherwise.

rateNon.description: Annual overpayment interest rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Non-corporate overpayment rate for the quarter beginning October 1, 2026. Enter a different single rate if your entries span other quarters. Official reference value 7% from CBP quarterly IRS interest rates notice (Federal Register 2026-19292) and IRS quarterly interest rates page, effective 2026-10-01 (quarter Oct 1 to Dec 31, 2026). Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when payer is individual; ignored otherwise.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_ieepa_tariff_refund_and_interest_ledger

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
